entities.label: XRAI → visionOS (RealityKit)
entities.summary: - **RealityKit:** right-handed Y-up, meters (matches OpenUSD) - **XRAI canonical:** left-handed Y-up, meters (Unity native) - Loader negates z on ingestion unless `graph.origin.handedness === "right"`
